sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Seven Laws and Rules of the Road

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A01
Solid red allows right turns after stopping unless banned, red arrows ban every turn until green, and flashing red behaves like a stop sign with movement after stopping, while all three still yield to right-of-way holders [A01].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A02
Flashing yellow needs no stop unlike flashing red, flashing yellow arrows leave the turn unprotected unlike green arrows, green still demands yielding to trapped traffic and exit room, and dark signals default to all-way stops [A02].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R01; confusables sec07-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A03
Steady DON'T WALK forbids crossing while flashing DON'T WALK forbids starting with drivers still yielding, countdowns and diagonal walks refine timing and direction, and STOP signs demand full stops where red YIELD signs demand only readiness [A03].
Why it matters: group signals-signs; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R01; confusables sec07-F04, sec07-F05 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A04
Red-and-white signs prohibit maneuvers while white signs post standing rules, a color split that separates bans from standing orders across the regulatory gallery [A04].
Why it matters: group signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F06 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A05
Yellow diamonds warn of conditions rather than ordering action, previewing curves, merges, crossings, and controls ahead instead of commanding stops or bans [A05].
Why it matters: group signs; difficulty low; prereq sec07-R04; confusables sec07-F07 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A06
DO NOT ENTER and WRONG WAY pair as the wrong-way system with red night reflectors as backup proof, while shape codes split meaning: circles and Xes for rails, pentagons for schools, diamonds for dangers, rectangles for rules [A06].
Why it matters: group signs; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R05; confusables sec07-F08 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A07
First arrival beats the right-side tiebreak which only fires on simultaneous arrival, all-way stops convert to the same tiebreak after stopping, T junctions exempt the through road entirely, and turns split duties between yielding lefts and scanning rights [A07].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F09, sec07-F10 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A08
Roundabouts replace signal obedience with yield-on-entry and counterclockwise circulation, multi-lane rings assigning rights to the right lane while straights keep their entry lane, unlike normal intersections where lane discipline follows arrows and signs [A08].
Why it matters: group right-of-way; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R07; confusables sec07-F11 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A09
Pedestrian status spans walkers to wheelchair riders yet binds them to road rules, driver duties escalate from slowing to full stops with eye contact as the cue, and unmarked crossings carry the same priority as painted ones [A09].
Why it matters: group pedestrians; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F12 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A10
Blind pedestrians hold unconditional priority with the stowed cane as the release signal, mountain passes trade on grade direction with downhill reversing, and truck blindness is mutual: hidden mirrors mean a hidden car [A10].
Why it matters: group priority-sharing; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R09; confusables sec07-F13, sec07-F14 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A11
Wide-load maneuvering inverts car instincts: read the truck's signals before passing, expect the two-rightmost-lane rule on wide divided roads, and treat safety zones as absolute no-drive areas with ten as the transit-passing ceiling [A11].
Why it matters: group sharing; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R10; confusables sec07-F15 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A12
Left-side passing of rail vehicles is banned with only three exceptions against the normal left-passing default, light rail preempts signals unlike ordinary traffic, and motorcycles demand full-lane generosity with three-second gaps and no in-lane passes [A12].
Why it matters: group sharing; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R11; confusables sec07-F16, sec07-F17 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A13
Sirens plus lights trigger pull-right-and-stop while stationary flashers trigger move-over-and-slow, intersection presence means clear-first-then-stop, officer orders override every sign, and the three-hundred-foot trailing ban has no grace distance [A13].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F18 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A14
NEVs pair a twenty-five cap with a thirty-five road bar, horse traffic pairs shared lanes with anti-scaring law, and cyclist rights pair freeway access without alternates against hazard-dodge and crosswalk options [A14].
Why it matters: group slow-share; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F19 [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A15
Cyclist duties mirror driver duties with helmet, visibility, and right-edge extras, night gear triples into lamp, rear light, and reflectors with distance ratings, and the right-edge rule carries a full exception list for passing, turning, hazards, and narrow lanes [A15].
Why it matters: group cyclists; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R14; confusables sec07-F20, sec07-F21 [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A16
Cyclist passing prefers a full lane change with the three-foot hold as fallback and waiting as the last resort, curbside merges and bike-lane entries staying conditional on safety and the two-hundred-foot turn window [A16].
Why it matters: group cyclists; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R15; confusables sec07-F22 [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A17
Work zones stack slowing, gaps, attention, and early merges as a package, fines start at one thousand-plus and double under enhanced or staffed conditions, worker assault adds jail time, and amber-lit rigs command the same move-over as emergencies [A17].
Why it matters: group workzones; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F23 [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A18
Placarded trucks stop at rails where ordinary trucks merely slow, weather slowing must not become flow blocking, tow and triple-axle rigs face lane confinement, and school zones pair the twenty-five cap with yellow-flasher warnings [A18].
Why it matters: group speeds; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F24, sec07-F25 [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A19
Red bus flashers stop both directions with a thousand-dollar, year-long penalty tail while divided highways exempt the far side, and the fifteen cap triples across blind intersections, alleys, and hidden-track crossings with flashing reds and fifteen-foot stops layering rail obedience [A19].
Why it matters: group schools-rails; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R18; confusables sec07-F26, sec07-F27 [A19].
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A20
Rail behavior pairs never-stop-on-tracks with never-enter-without-exit-room and mandatory-stop watching, districts pair the twenty-five cap with posted overrides, and the must-not list pairs smoking, dumping, overloads, cargo limits, flags and lights, riders, video, and litter as one prohibition family [A20].
Why it matters: group rails-prohibitions; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R19; confusables sec07-F28, sec07-F29 [A20].
Source: [A20 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A21
Window stickers shrink to measured squares in fixed corners, funeral processions trade markings and headlights for priority, plates stay legible and stock, and evasion penalties staircase from misdemeanor jail through injury years to manslaughter decades with impound and contest penalties alongside [A21].
Why it matters: group fixtures-penalties; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F30, sec07-F31 [A21].
Source: [A21 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A22
Skipped court dates convert to suspension plus record marks, convictions linger thirty-six-plus months from any state, negligent status trips on the four-six-eight point staircase across twelve-twenty-four-thirty-six months, one-point tickets trade for school once per eighteen months, and overload ends in probation, suspension, or revocation with revocation forced for hit-and-run and injurious recklessness [A22].
Why it matters: group records; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F32, sec07-F33 [A22].
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A23
Provisional sanctions staircase one event to action, two to a thirty-day ban with the licensed-adult exception, three to suspension plus probation, substances to year bans into age twenty, with eighteen erasing nothing; hearing rights lapse on the ten-fourteen day split [A23].
Why it matters: group provisional; difficulty high; prereq sec07-R22; confusables sec07-F34 [A23].
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A24
Hearings grant the full defense toolkit against a documents-only case with subpoenas on the driver, unsafe drivers route through reexamination requests, and record privacy narrows to conditions, addresses, and social numbers [A24].
Why it matters: group hearings; difficulty medium; prereq sec07-R23; confusables sec07-F35 [A24].
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0062]
